name: Pipeshift
long_description: Pipeshift offers ultra-low latency infrastructure for engineering teams to run real-time inference in production. We offer latency-optimized runtimes for voice, chat, and physical AI, paired with distributed orchestration that routes and auto-scales across clusters and regions — typically 3 to 5X lower time-to-first-audio, so teams serve 2x the users on the same hardware.
one_liner: Inference for real-time voice and chat
